newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks surge on Zedillo development plan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks surge on Zedillo development plan.

text.p: Mexican stocks continued an upward record-breaking march in intraday trade on Tuesday following President Ernesto Zedillo's announcement of the National Program to Finance Development, traders said.
The market's leading IPC share index charged ahead 1.70 percent to 4,071.06 points -- a new intra-session high for Mexican shares.

"It is basically the plan that is moving us forward, although the Dow Jones is helping as well," one trader said from the floor of the market. New York's main index was above 7,300 points, up 48.51 points at 7,337.51.

In announcing the plan which sees economic growth at a five percent annual average, Zedillo also said May inflation will be lower than the 1.08 percent in April and that in the last 21 months, 1.5 million jobs have been created.
